oracle_files.models/sg_result_991dec701d.sql:
WITH customer_cohorts AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', FULL_DATE) AS cohort_date,
    CUSTOMER_KEY,
    MIN(FULL_DATE) AS first_order_date
  FROM ANALYTICS.FACT_SALES
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', FULL_DATE), CUSTOMER_KEY
),
cohort_customers AS (
  SELECT 
    cc.cohort_date,
    cc.CUSTOMER_KEY,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', fs.FULL_DATE) AS order_month,
    fs.PROFIT_AMOUNT,
    fs.TOTAL_AMOUNT AS revenue,
    fs.DISCOUNT_AMOUNT,
    fs.QUANTITY AS order_count
  FROM customer_cohorts cc
  JOIN ANALYTICS.FACT_SALES fs ON cc.CUSTOMER_KEY = fs.CUSTOMER_KEY
),
cohort_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    cohort_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CUSTOMER_KEY) AS cohort_size,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN order_month = cohort_date THEN CUSTOMER_KEY END) AS day_0_customers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN order_month <= DATE_TRUNC('month', cohort_date + INTERVAL '7 days') THEN CUSTOMER_KEY END) AS day_7_customers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN order_month <= DATE_TRUNC('month', cohort_date + INTERVAL '30 days') THEN CUSTOMER_KEY END) AS day_30_customers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN order_month <= DATE_TRUNC('month', cohort_date + INTERVAL '90 days') THEN CUSTOMER_KEY END) AS day_90_customers
  FROM cohort_customers
  GROUP BY cohort_date
),
channel_monthly AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('month', fs.FULL_DATE) AS month_start,
    fs.CHANNEL_KEY,
    fs.CHANNEL_KEY AS channel_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT fs.ORDER_ID) AS order_count,
    SUM(fs.TOTAL_AMOUNT) AS revenue,
    SUM(fs.PROFIT_AMOUNT) AS profit,
    SUM(fs.DISCOUNT_AMOUNT) AS discount_amount,
    NULLIF(SUM(fs.PROFIT_AMOUNT) / NULLIF(SUM(fs.TOTAL_AMOUNT), 0), 0) AS margin_rate,
    NULLIF(SUM(fs.TOTAL_AMOUNT) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT fs.ORDER_ID), 0), 0) AS avg_order_value,
    NULLIF(SUM(fs.DISCOUNT_AMOUNT) / NULLIF(SUM(fs.TOTAL_AMOUNT), 0), 0) AS discount_rate
  FROM ANALYTICS.FACT_SALES fs
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', fs.FULL_DATE), fs.CHANNEL_KEY
),
retention_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    cohort_date,
    cohort_size,
    day_0_customers,
    day_7_customers,
    day_30_customers,
    day_90_customers,
    NULLIF(day_0_customers * 1.0 / cohort_size, 0) AS day_0_retention,
    NULLIF(day_7_customers * 1.0 / cohort_size, 0) AS day_7_retention,
    NULLIF(day_30_customers * 1.0 / cohort_size, 0) AS day_30_retention,
    NULLIF(day_90_customers * 1.0 / cohort_size, 0) AS day_90_retention
  FROM cohort_metrics
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    rm.cohort_date,
    rm.month_start,
    rm.channel_key,
    rm.channel_code,
    rm.cohort_size,
    rm.order_count,
    rm.day_0_customers,
    rm.day_7_customers,
    rm.day_30_customers,
    rm.day_90_customers,
    rm.revenue,
    rm.profit,
    rm.discount_amount,
    rm.margin_rate,
    rm.avg_order_value,
    rm.discount_rate,
    rr.day_0_retention,
    rr.day_7_retention,
    rr.day_30_retention,
    rr.day_90_retention
  FROM channel_monthly rm
  CROSS JOIN retention_rates rr
)
SELECT * FROM combined
WHERE cohort_date IS NOT NULL AND month_start IS NOT NULL
